overview: This Senate resolution honors former Senator Christopher "Kit" Bond of Missouri, who died on May 13, 2025. It recounts his career as Missouri's state auditor, two-time governor, and senator from 1987 to 2011, including his work on housing, infrastructure, farming, national defense, literacy, and the Parents as Teachers program. The resolution expresses the Senate's sorrow, sends copies to the House and to his family, and has the Senate adjourn that day in his memory. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on May 22, 2025.
for: Supporters say it is a fitting tribute to more than 40 years of public service by a former colleague.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic: it does not change any law or spending.
